challenges.title: Defective Electronics & Demanded Cash Refund
challenges.shortDescription: De-escalate an upset shopper demanding an immediate cash refund for a malfunctioning item.
challenges.mission: Listen calmly, acknowledge the customer frustration, inspect the product or receipt, and offer a valid store policy resolution.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I bought this wireless speaker yesterday for my anniversary party tonight, and the charging port is completely broken! I don't want an exchange, I want my 4,000 rupees back in cash right now!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting a quick refund or replacement without hassle

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Expresses strong anger about the defective product.
unacceptablePromises: Do not promise cash refund without receipt if policy forbids it.

challenges.title: Tailoring Disaster 3 Hours Before Wedding
challenges.shortDescription: A furious customer discovers tailored trousers were cut 2 inches too short right before a family wedding.
challenges.mission: Empathize with the time-critical emergency, assess alteration options or arrange emergency off-the-rack styling.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Look at these trousers! Your master tailor cut them two inches above my ankles! My brother's wedding reception is in three hours! What on earth am I supposed to wear?!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands an immediate solution while rejecting slow apologies.
possibleSolutions: Release turn-up hem if margin exists

challenges.title: Humiliating Security Sensor False Alarm
challenges.shortDescription: Handle a humiliated regular customer stopped loudly by security after a cashier missed a security tag.
challenges.mission: Restore customer dignity, apologize sincerely for the cashier oversight, quickly remove the tag, and offer a courtesy gesture.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: The exit alarm went off and your security guards treated me like a shoplifter in front of fifty people! I've been shopping here for seven years! Your cashier forgot to remove this security tag!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: public vindication and genuine acknowledgment of disrespect

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands an apology and an explanation of why staff were negligent.

challenges.title: Rude Cashier Complaint During Festival Rush
challenges.shortDescription: Pacify an insulted customer claiming the billing clerk rolled eyes and tossed their shopping bags.
challenges.mission: Listen attentively to the behavioral complaint, validate the customer feelings without throwing colleagues under the bus, and ensure smooth checkout.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your billing clerk at counter 4 just rolled his eyes at me and literally threw my dress into the carry bag because I asked for a split payment! I demand to speak to whoever is in charge!

guestProfile.personality: firm and intolerant of poor service

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Expects swift leadership intervention and respectful closure.
